releaseNotes.zh-CN:
ADC 0.2.8（测试渠道）

修复静止页面截图超时、取帧与停止释放行为；停流时在已有屏幕共享会话上有限恢复一次。
统一完整屏幕坐标，修复底部控件手势校验。
支持可选 JPEG 截图，默认仍为无损 PNG。
与新版服务协商在取任务时合并确认，减少一次签名请求；旧服务保持兼容。
新版托管和本地 MCP 直接返回截图图片，并支持已完成异步任务图片交付与授权资源读取。

沿用测试版签名，覆盖更新保留配对。安装和屏幕共享授权仍由设备所有者确认；用户接管与控制会话到期继续生效。更新后刷新或重连 MCP。
releaseNotes.en:
ADC 0.2.8 (testing channel)

Repairs static-screen capture timeouts, frame ownership and stop/release handling, with one bounded recovery on the existing authorized display.
Uses full-screen coordinates for bottom-edge gestures.
Adds optional JPEG capture while retaining PNG as the default.
Negotiates inline acknowledgement with updated services, preserving compatibility with older services.
Updated hosted and local MCP deliver screenshot images, including completed asynchronous results and authorized artifact resource reads.

Retains the testing certificate and pairing on in-place updates. Installation and screen-sharing consent remain under the device owner's control; user takeover and control-session expiry remain enforced. Refresh or reconnect MCP after updating.
